sources.title: GitHub - stephansturges/WALDO: Whereabouts Ascertainment for Low-lying ...
sources.snippet: WALDO is a detection AI model, based on a large YOLO-v8 backbone and my own synthetic data pipeline. The model is capable of detecting these classes of items in overhead imagery ranging in altitude from about 30 feet to satellite imagery!
